description: Say whether the figures a snapshot_hash names are still the ones served, and for which company and date. No API key is needed: anyone given the hash from a point-in-time response, such as the reviewer of a figure quoted from it, can check it. verdict is MATCHES when those figures are served and NOT_FOUND when none are. The hash is the whole request, so a caller can check what they were given and nothing else. The figures themselves are returned by GET /v1/edgar/as-of/{date}/financials/{cik}, which takes a key.

snapshot_hash.description: The snapshot_hash from a point-in-time response.

name: query_verify_snapshot
title: Verify a point-in-time snapshot hash
